body:
# ENGLISH

🔧 BetterCraft – Crafting Improvement DataPack

BetterCraft is a DataPack that improves and rebalances several Minecraft crafting recipes to make them more logical, useful, and accessible, while staying balanced for a vanilla-friendly survival experience.

This DataPack reworks crafts such as:

🍎 Golden Apple, with a redesigned recipe

🔔 Bell, now fully craftable

🍏 Enchanted Golden Apple (Notch Apple), available through a balanced end-game recipe

The goal of BetterCraft is to enhance gameplay by adding crafting recipes that feel natural and should have existed in vanilla Minecraft, without breaking game balance.

✨ Future updates are planned to add more improved and new crafting recipes over time.

📦 Survival-friendly
⚙️ Easy to install
🔥 Perfect for vanilla-plus worlds and servers
